description: This file is a Java test class named 'PatientServiceTest' that contains automated unit tests for the 'PatientService' class within the OpenMRS medical record system. It verifies various functionalities related to patient management, including creation, retrieval, merging, validation, and retention of patient data. The class uses JUnit 5 for testing and imports numerous dependencies for assertions, mocking, and domain-specific operations.

classes.name: PatientServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that conducts unit and integration tests on the 'PatientService' implementation within the OpenMRS platform. It extends 'BaseContextSensitiveTest' to leverage context and database setup for testing patient-related operations such as creation, retrieval, merging, validation, and status changes.

methods.name: getAllIdentifierValidators
methods.description: Tests that retrieving all registered patient identifier validators returns the complete expected set.

methods.name: getIdentifierValidator
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific identifier validators by class name, including handling of empty strings.

methods.name: shouldCreatePatient
methods.description: Validates that a new patient can be created with valid domain data and saved successfully.

methods.name: shouldCreatePatientWithValidatedIdentifier
methods.description: Tests creation of patients with identifiers validated according to specific rules, including handling invalid check digits.

methods.name: shouldGetPatientsByIdentifier
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of patients by their unique identifiers, ensuring the correct patient is fetched.

methods.name: shouldGetPatientsByNameShouldLimitSize
methods.description: Ensures that the patient retrieval by name respects maximum result limits to prevent large queries.

methods.name: shouldGetPatientsByIdegntifierAndIdentifierType
methods.description: Tests fetching patients by combining identifier strings with specific identifier types.

methods.name: shouldGetPatientsByIdentifierAndMoreThanOneIdentifierTypes
methods.description: Verifies that querying with multiple identifier types correctly returns the matching patients.

methods.name: purgePatientIdentifierType_shouldDeleteTypeFromDatabase
methods.description: Confirms that deleting a patient identifier type from the database works as expected.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifierType_shouldCreateNewType
methods.description: Tests creation of a new patient identifier type.

methods.name: savePatientIdentifierType_shouldUpdateExistingType
methods.description: Checks that an existing patient identifier type can be updated correctly.

methods.name: unretirePatientIdentifierType_shouldUnretirePatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Verifies that a retired identifier type can be successfully unretired.

methods.name: unretirePatientIdentifierType_shouldReturnUnretiredPatientIdentifierType
methods.description: Ensures that the method returns an unretired type with cleared retirement info.

methods.name: unvoidPatient_shouldUnvoidGivenPatient
methods.description: Test that a voided patient can be unvoided, restoring active status.

methods.name: unvoidPatient_shouldReturnUnvoidedPatient
methods.description: Verifies that the unvoid method resets the patient's voided flags.

methods.name: voidPatient_shouldVoidGivenPatientWithGivenReason
methods.description: Checks that voiding a patient sets the void flags and stores the reason.

methods.name: voidPatient_shouldVoidAllPatientIdentifiersAssociatedWithGivenPatient
methods.description: Ensures all associated patient identifiers are voided when the patient is voided.

methods.name: voidPatient_shouldReturnVoidedPatientWithGivenReason
methods.description: Verifies the returned patient's void reason matches the input.

methods.name: voidPatient_shouldReturnNullWhenPatientIsNull
methods.description: Confirms that attempting to void a null patient returns null without errors.

methods.name: getPatientByUuid_shouldFindObjectGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Tests fetching a patient by a valid UUID.

methods.name: getPatientByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoObjectFoundWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Ensures that an invalid UUID results in null output.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByUuid_shouldFindObjectGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieval of patient identifier by UUID for valid input.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoObjectFoundWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Ensures null output for nonexistent UUID.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeByUuid_shouldFindObjectGivenValidUuid
methods.description: Tests retrieval of patient identifier type by UUID for valid input.

methods.name: getPatientIdentifierTypeByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNoObjectFoundWithGivenUuid
methods.description: Ensures null output for invalid UUID.

methods.name: mergePatients_shouldMergeVisitAndEncounterData
methods.description: Verifies that merging two patients consolidates their visits, encounters, and related data, and updates audit logs.
